mentions.name: Personal German conversation partner
mentions.description: A personal conversation partner for practicing German: the user speaks in German, one level corrects mistakes and allows reformulating the statement, and another level responds to the intended idea, repeated in a rinse-and-repeat loop. Built for personal use, not as a product.
mentions.source_excerpt: Personal (as in, "for personal use, not a product") conversation partner -- I speak in German, one level is correcting the mistakes, allowing me to reformulate the statement, another level is responding to the intended idea. Rinse, repeat.
